recommendation: Allocate 10 units to Support, 8 to Engineering, and 7 to Sales. This proportional split respects each department’s relative request size and uses all 25 available units. The 5-unit shortfall is distributed in line with demand: Support receives its exact proportional share (40%), Engineering takes a rounded-down share (8 vs. 8.33), and Sales receives the remaining units (7 vs. 6.67). Contingency plan for the 14-day wait until the next delivery: each department should activate a temporary conservation protocol—Support should defer non-critical hardware swaps and extend ticket SLAs where safe; Engineering should prioritize maintenance to extend current component life and delay non-blocking upgrades; Sales should reserve units for the highest-probability deals and pause lower-priority demos. A daily stand-up between the three departments should track actual burn rate so remaining stock can be rebalanced if an urgent need arises before the shipment arrives.
